candidates.name: Neurofibroma
support_spans: a solitary, completely cystic mass in the left L5–S1 foraminal zone extending along the course of the sciatic nerve
The lesion was hypointense on T1-weighted images, hyperintense on T2-weighted images, and demonstrated peripheral rim enhancement
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of a solitary cystic mass along the sciatic nerve with specific imaging characteristics is consistent with a neurofibroma.
